-- Expire the old version
UPDATE dw.dim_product
SET is_current = 0, expiration_date = DATEADD(DAY,-1,@LoadDate)
WHERE sku = @Sku AND is_current = 1;

-- Insert the new version
INSERT INTO dw.dim_product (sku, unit_price, is_current, effective_date)
VALUES (@Sku, @UnitPrice, 1, @LoadDate);
caption: A new surrogate key per version -- historical sales keep the old price.
A delete scoped to one date makes re-running tonight's load safe.
